Specification: This module is a small syntactic test specification that defines several operators over tuples and set constructions. It models no transition system and declares no variables, actions, temporal behavior, or fault model; instead it exercises parsing of operator applications, tuple constructors, labeled expressions, and a LET-bound operator inside a set comprehension. The file appears intended to test extraction and handling of higher-arity operator constants, tuple expressions, and local LET definitions rather than to verify safety or liveness properties.
